name: M7.RawCoverage.translate_signature
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N) (s t : ZMod N), M7.RecipeSignature.signature (M7.Action.act (M7.Action.translate s t) c) = M7.RecipeSignature.signature c
guidance: Use accepted action_signature with translate. Rewrite source_tau_equal and tau_one using signature_properties. Alternatively instantiate accepted translation_invariant with E=fun F=>F=signature c and use reverse direction of the equivalence. Preserve the entire polynomial including multiplicities. Return tactic lines without leading by.
